mechanism.base_form_invariant: Removing the final suffix glyph recovers the same encoded base form for every occurrence of the same plaintext token under a fixed key.
mechanism.bridge_invariant: Phase-3A.4 K=4 generated corpus must be byte-identical to Phase-3A.3 K=4 for the same source, split, and seed.
mechanism.extension_suffix_policy: Suffixes V0005..V0016 are deterministically ordered using a separate extension hash that cannot alter the first four legacy suffixes.
mechanism.legacy_suffix_policy: The first four suffixes are exactly the frozen Phase-3A.3 master suffix order for the same source/seed.
mechanism.name: base_form_suffix_extended
mechanism.suffix_choice: Use the exact Phase-3A.3 stable hash namespace and inputs: stable_hash('base-form-suffix-choice-v1', seed, line_index, token_index) % K. Plaintext token identity is excluded.
mechanism.suffix_set_policy: K=4,8,16 activate prefixes of one 16-suffix master ordering. The K=4 prefix is exactly the Phase-3A.3 four-suffix master ordering.
mechanism.token_length_control: Every ciphertext token is base length + 1 for K=4,8,16. Only suffix identity multiplicity changes.

parent_phase3a3.bridge_requirement: For every source/seed, Phase-3A.4 K=4 corpus.jsonl must be byte-for-byte identical to the frozen Phase-3A.3 K=4 corpus.jsonl.
